_comment: Structural map of mealbudgeter.html for fast lookup before edits. Line numbers are a snapshot (regenerate after large edits). The Android port mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html is a byte-identical copy — always re-sync after editing the main file.

meta.androidPort: mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html (must stay byte-identical; copy after every change)
meta.type: single self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + vanilla JS, no build step, no deps except two runtime APIs below)

runtimeAPIs.navigator.share: shopping-list share (WhatsApp/Messenger on mobile), clipboard fallback

tabs.note: 5 tabs; icon+label buttons (span.tab-ico + span.tab-lbl, data-i18n on label). Labels hidden on mobile (icon-only). Default active = home. switchTab(name) at 1280; home nav cards use [data-goto].

tab-home.layout: hero -> home-nav-title 'Get started' -> home-nav (4-col grid, nav cards ABOVE) -> home-nav-title 'This week' -> home-summary (6-col 1x6 grid BELOW)

slotModal.note: TWO pickers — a Meal (food items) and a Beverage (beverage items)

slotModel.shape: mealPlan[day][mealTypeId] = null | { meal: ref|null, drink: ref|null }
slotModel.ref: { recipeId, qty } (a recipe) | { ingredientId, qty } (a pantry item planned directly)
slotModel.note: Each cell = an eatable MEAL + an optional drinkable BEVERAGE, stacked. Meal picker offers category==='food' items; drink picker offers category==='beverage' items. resolveRef() resolves a single ref; slotMeal()/slotDrink() get the two sub-refs; slotCost() sums both. Extend resolveRef / slot helpers — not each consumer — for slot logic. Legacy single-ref/string slots are auto-migrated in loadState (routed to meal or drink by the item's category).

slotMeal.note: meal sub-ref (tolerates legacy single-ref/string as meal)

slotCost.note: meal.cost + drink.cost for a whole cell

loadState.note: defaults + migrations: string slot -> {recipeId,qty}; single-ref slot -> {meal,drink} routed by category; backfill mealTypes/mealPlan keys; shopping* maps. Category needs NO migration (reads use `|| 'food'`).

switchTab.note: wired to tab-btns and [data-goto] home cards

deleteIngredient.note: clears recipes + meal/drink sub-slots + shopping* maps

renderPlanner.note: compact grid; cell shows meal (top) + 🥤 drink line (under) + slotCost; hasPlannable = recipes||ingredients

fillSlotSelect.note: (select, category) fills with food OR beverage recipes+ingredients, grouped, values r:/i:

openSlotModal.note: fills meal picker (food) + drink picker (beverage); prefills from slot.meal/slot.drink

randomizeHandler.note: pool = food-category recipes + food-category ingredients; sets MEAL sub-slot only, PRESERVES existing drink; confirm if meals exist

renderShoppingList.note: TWO-ROW card: .shopping-main (checkbox+name+🥤+tag) then .shopping-detail (qty+cost+remove ✕). Refresh btn clears shoppingExcluded.

buildReportText.note: weekly plan lines show 'Meal + 🥤 Drink — cost' via resolveRef(meal)/resolveRef(drink)+slotCost

renderHome.note: summary: weeklyCost, budget left (under/over), #recipes, #ingredients, #beverages (recipes+ingredients category==='beverage'), #planned via slotFilled

keyEventHandlers.note: anonymous listeners near their section; search 'getElementById("<id>").addEventListener'

stateSchema.ingredients: [{ id, name, category:'food'|'beverage', unit, pricePerUnit:Number, lastUpdated:ms, translations:{[lang]:String} }]
stateSchema.recipes: [{ id, name, category:'food'|'beverage', ingredients:[{ ingredientId, quantity:Number }] }]
stateSchema.mealTypes: [{ id, order:Number, labelKey?(builtin i18n key), name?(custom) }] (builtins breakfast/lunch/dinner)
stateSchema.mealPlan: { [day monday..sunday]: { [mealTypeId]: null | { meal: ref|null, drink: ref|null } } }; ref = {recipeId,qty} | {ingredientId,qty}. Legacy shapes auto-migrated.

conventions.singleFile: One HTML file. Android port is a plain copy. Do NOT split into external .js unless asked.
conventions.i18n: I18N.en (808) / I18N.es (932), mirrored. Static: data-i18n / data-i18n-placeholder (works on <option>/<span>). Dynamic: t(key,vars). ADD NEW KEYS TO BOTH. Never translate user data except the ingredient-translation feature.
conventions.beverages: category:'food'|'beverage' on ingredients AND recipes = eatable vs drinkable. Meal picker = food, drink picker = beverage. Each planner cell holds one of each. catIcon() renders 🥤.
conventions.afterEdit: 1) browser test (server 'mealbudgeter' port 3134 /mealbudgeter.html) no console errors; 2) copy mealbudgeter.html -> mealbudgeter-android/www/index.html; 3) regenerate this map if structure shifted.

i18nKeysAddedThisIteration: tab_home(existing),home_summary_title,field_meal,field_drink,none_option,btn_save (slot modal now Meal+Beverage pickers; randomize_no_recipes reworded; planner_empty reworded). Prior keys: field_category,cat_food,cat_beverage,optgroup_recipes,optgroup_pantry,select_item,btn_refresh,home_*,tab_home,+ all base keys from earlier iterations.
